source='''def transform(grid):
    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    counts = {}
    for row in grid:
        for value in row:
            counts[value] = counts.get(value, 0) + 1
    background = max(counts, key=counts.get)
    marker = 2
    points = [(r, c) for r in range(h) for c in range(w) if grid[r][c] not in (background, marker)]
    r0, r1 = min(r for r, c in points), max(r for r, c in points)
    c0, c1 = min(c for r, c in points), max(c for r, c in points)
    full_rows = [r for r in range(h) if all(value == marker for value in grid[r])]
    full_cols = [c for c in range(w) if all(grid[r][c] == marker for r in range(h))]
    out = [[background for _ in range(w)] for _ in range(h)]
    if full_rows:
        mr = full_rows[0]
        dr = (mr - 1 - r1) if mr > r1 else (mr + 1 - r0)
        for r, c in points:
            out[r + dr][c] = grid[r][c]
        out[mr] = grid[mr][:]
        trail = (r0 + dr - 1) if dr >= 0 else (r1 + dr + 1)
        out[trail] = [8] * w
    else:
        mc = full_cols[0]
        dc = (mc - 1 - c1) if mc > c1 else (mc + 1 - c0)
        for r, c in points:
            out[r][c + dc] = grid[r][c]
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][mc] = marker
        trail = (c0 + dc - 1) if dc >= 0 else (c1 + dc + 1)
        for r in range(h):
            out[r][trail] = 8
    return out
'''
